description: Connector hardening + new API endpoints (datasources mapping/validate/upload, preflight) + POST /runs gating. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs schemas for mapping validation, needs IngestionRun model, needs DataSource.mapping column). Independent from FEAT-003 (dashboard).
steps: In worker/src/services/data_connector.py, add two exception classes near the top: class DataSourceNotConfigured(Exception): def __init__(self, org_id): super().__init__(f'No active DataSource configured for org {org_id!r}'); self.org_id = org_id. And: class ConfigurationError(ValueError): pass.

In worker/src/services/data_connector.py PostgreSQLConnector.__init__: validate self.sales_table and self.telemetry_table against regex ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$ using re.fullmatch; raise ValueError(f'Unsafe table name: {name!r}') on failure.

In worker/src/services/data_connector.py PostgreSQLConnector.query_sales_data: fix the f-string table injection by using sqlalchemy.sql.quoted_name. Change the FROM clause to use f'FROM {quoted_name(self.sales_table, quote=True)}' where quoted_name is imported from sqlalchemy.sql. Fix the malformed interval in query_telemetry: replace `INTERVAL ':hours hours'` with `NOW() - (:hours * INTERVAL '1 hour')` (PostgreSQL-compatible syntax without SQLAlchemy function).

In worker/src/services/data_connector.py RESTAPIConnector.__init__: after the allowlist check, parse the hostname from base_url using urllib.parse.urlparse, call socket.getaddrinfo(hostname, None), and for each (family, type, proto, canonname, sockaddr) check if the IP in sockaddr[0] falls in any private range. Use ipaddress module: ip_obj = ipaddress.ip_address(sockaddr[0]); if ip_obj.is_private or ip_obj.is_loopback or ip_obj.is_link_local: raise ValueError(f'REST connector resolved to private IP: {sockaddr[0]}').

In worker/src/services/data_connector.py CSVFileConnector.query_sales_data, query_telemetry, _read_csv: remove open() calls. Replace method bodies with: raise ValueError('CSV file upload required; file path access disabled. Use POST /datasources/{id}/upload instead.'). Update health_check to return False.

In worker/src/services/data_connector.py BigQueryConnector.__init__: after setting self.project_id, check if config.get('service_account_ref') is empty AND config.get('credentials_path') is empty AND os.getenv('GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS', '') is empty. If all three are absent, raise ConfigurationError('BigQuery requires service_account_ref in config; application default credentials are not permitted in production.').

In worker/src/services/data_connector.py get_connector_for_org: replace the entire fallback block (the GCP env check and CSV seed fallback) with: raise DataSourceNotConfigured(org_id). Keep the DB lookup try block intact.

In api/src/services/data_connector_shim.py: in the primary try-import block add DataSourceNotConfigured and ConfigurationError to the from services.data_connector import (...) statement. In the except ImportError fallback block, define DataSourceNotConfigured and ConfigurationError mirroring the worker definitions, and update fallback get_connector_for_org to raise DataSourceNotConfigured(org_id). Add both to __all__.

Create api/src/routes/datasources.py with APIRouter(prefix='/datasources', tags=['Data Source Mapping']). Implement: (A) PUT /{source_id}/mapping — body {mapping: dict[str,str]}; load DataSource from DB filtering by source_id; call assert_same_org(tenant_ctx.org_id, ds.org_id); validate every value in mapping dict against known canonical fields collected via {f: None for schema in [SalesLine, TelemetryFrame, WeighbridgeSlip, Invoice, PurchaseOrder] for f in schema.model_fields}; on unknown field raise HTTPException(422, detail=f'Unknown canonical field {field!r}'); apply mapping to a 5-row preview (reuse connector.query_sales_data or query_telemetry based on ds.purpose); store ds.mapping = mapping; return {source_id, mapping, preview_rows}. (B) POST /{source_id}/validate — load DataSource; connect via create_connector; fetch 10 rows; apply ds.mapping to each row (rename keys); validate each row against the schema matching ds.purpose; collect errors [{row:int, field:str, message:str}]; return {valid: bool, total_rows, valid_rows, errors, sample_rows}. (C) POST /{source_id}/upload — UploadFile param; check content_type == 'text/csv' else 422; check file.size <= 52_428_800 else 413; read bytes, decode utf-8, parse with csv.DictReader; store rows in module-level _csv_cache[source_id]; return {source_id, rows_total, preview_rows: first 5, columns}.

Create api/src/routes/preflight.py with APIRouter(prefix='/runs', tags=['Preflight']). Implement async helper run_preflight_checks(org_id, session) -> dict that runs all 5 checks (data_source_configured, column_mapping_valid, active_regulatory_pack, plant_calibration, obligation_ledger) per the plan spec. Checks 3-5 use bare text() SQL in try/except; on any Exception set ok=False, message='Phase 3 tables not yet migrated'. Implement GET /runs/preflight endpoint that calls this helper and returns {ready, checks}.
In api/src/routes/__init__.py: import datasources_router from .datasources and preflight_router from .preflight; add both to __all__.

In api/src/main.py: import datasources_router and preflight_router from src.routes; add app.include_router(preflight_router, prefix=API_V1_STR) BEFORE app.include_router(runs_router, prefix=API_V1_STR); add app.include_router(datasources_router, prefix=API_V1_STR).

In api/src/routes/runs.py create_run handler: at the top of the function body, after resolving org_id, open a DB session and call preflight_result = await run_preflight_checks(org_id, session). Import run_preflight_checks from src.routes.preflight. If not preflight_result['ready'], raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail={'error': 'preflight_failed', 'preflight': preflight_result}).

cd worker && python -m pytest tests/ -x passes all existing tests
